scope: JEP 2023 vol.10 doi:10.5802/jep.232 -- original reader page / native position anchors; one anchor per numbered position of the single existing structure-index, tying the printed number and page to the native line span and to the page-number, heading-position and visual checks; this is not a second structural index and does not restate statements

native_line_number_basis.positions: 1-based line numbers in the native file
native_line_number_basis.note: the file has 2256 newlines, ends without a trailing newline, and splits on newline into 2257 elements whose last element is content, so the file is 2257 lines with no trailing empty element; jep.233 is the opposite case (661 lines, ends with a newline)

page_number_basis.evidence: P3 header carries printed 772 and P45 carries 814, with P3-P45 consecutive; the P1 cover declares the article range p. 771-814 but carries no folio of its own, so the printed area starts at 772
page_number_basis.header_layout: odd pages: folio at x~113 then the author line M. Bourdon & B. Remy; even pages: article title first then folio at x~469-472; the running head sits at y~125-133, below the y<120 band used for jep.233; the footer J.E.P. -- M., 2023, tome 10 carries no folio

numbering_note: the native file uses one shared counter for every theorem-like environment (newtheorem{...}[thm] with the other environments inheriting [thm]) and the printed document also lets displayed numbered formulas consume the same counter, so the printed numbering shows gaps at 0.4, 6.2, 6.9 and 6.11 and jumps over the numbers those formulas take; the appendix is printed A.1-A.10 although the same shared counter runs to 8.10 there, and the four main theorems of the introduction are printed with letters A-D rather than arabic numbers; the 52 numbered positions of the structure-index are the environment headings only, formulas excluded

page_number_check.method: per-page text extraction in the band y<140 of the 45-page reader.pdf, taking the arabic word of the header band on every page and comparing it with physical+769
page_number_check.folios_found: exactly one arabic folio per page on P3-P45, all equal to physical+769 (772-814), odd pages folio at x~113 and even pages at x~469-472
page_number_check.pages_without_folio_reason: P1 is the journal cover and P2 the title/catalog page; neither carries a printed folio, and the 771 printed on the cover is the declared first page of the article, not a folio
page_number_check.header_layout: odd pages: folio then author line; even pages: article title then folio; header baseline at y~125-133

heading_position_check.method: line-initial heading-form regex over the text layer of every page carrying an assigned heading (heading word, printed number, optional bracketed citation, then the em dash), counting hits per assigned position and listing heading-like lines not assigned to that page
heading_position_check.hits_per_position: exactly one hit for 51 of the 52 positions, two hits for the remaining position (Theorem 6.8)
heading_position_check.result: every one of the 52 assigned headings was found as a line-initial heading-form line on its assigned page; the one position with two hits is Theorem 6.8 on P38, where a later line begins with the same words as running prose (Theorem 6.8 applies.), so the second hit is a prose mention and not a second heading; the only heading-form lines not assigned to their page are two prose citations that happen to start a line on P42 (Lemma 4.2 in [IL93]. and Lemma A.6, one has), neither of which is a heading; a whole-page text search without the line-initial anchor was rejected for this work because it matches in-sentence cross references such as Theorem 0.2 below
heading_position_check.crops_note: no heading crops were rendered for this work; the check above uses the text layer, and the visual evidence is the full-page renders listed under visual_check

visual_check.page_1_note: P1 is the JEP cover; it declares the article pages 771-814 but carries no folio
visual_check.page_2_note: P2 is the title/catalog page with the DOI, the authors and the abstract; no folio
visual_check.page_3_note: P3 carries the printed folio 772 in the header and opens the numbered text with Question 0.1
visual_check.page_16_note: P16 carries folio 785 and a displayed chain of Lp-cohomology identifications; the lines are set as text and inline math, with no figure or diagram on the page
visual_check.page_28_note: P28 carries folio 797 and a displayed sum S = S_floor((l-2)/2) approximating 1/2 sigma; the 12 vector drawings on this page are rule lines and fraction/radical artwork, not a figure
visual_check.page_44_45_note: P44 (folio 813) ends the body and starts the bibliography; P45 (folio 814) carries the last references, so the article closes on the last page of the reader
visual_check.conclusion: the printed folios, the printed numbering and the native positions agree on every page exercised; no page was found where a heading sits on a different page than the alignment claims, and no page carries a captioned figure

figure_check.native: no graphics-inclusion command, no tikzpicture, and no figure, center, tabular, picture or verbatim environment anywhere in the 2257-line native file
figure_check.pdf: the page-object scan over all 45 pages finds raster images only on P1 (cover, 3 images) and P2 (title/catalog page, 1 image); every other page is text plus vector drawings that are rule lines, fraction bars and math glyph artwork, and no page of the text layer contains a Figure or Table caption line
figure_check.conclusion: the article has no mathematical figures; the unit set needs no figure assets

line_number_convention: positions are 1-based inclusive line ranges in JEP_2023__10__771_0.tex; the file has 2256 newlines and no trailing newline, so a split on newline yields 2257 elements whose last element is content, and the file is 2257 lines
page_number_convention_corrections: line count is 2257, not 2256: 2256 is the number of newline characters, and the missing trailing newline makes the 2257th split element content rather than an empty tail
the printed area starts at 772 on P3, not 771; printed = physical + 769, and the 771-814 range printed on the cover is the article declaration
the header band of this journal sits lower than the one used for jep.233: the folio occupies y~125-133, so a y<120 band returns no folio at all and the check must use y<140
on even pages the article title runs first and the folio sits at x~469-472; on odd pages the folio sits at x~113
